blind.description: A stylized roasted pig mounted on a spit rod with a turning crank handle, supported at both ends by dark metal trestles. Beneath the pig is a low rectangular stone-brick hearth filled with ash, coals, and charcoal logs. The pig is bound with decorative rope cords around its torso and legs. All surfaces are smooth, continuous, and solid, modeled in a polished fantasy/hand-painted game art style without floating fragments or mesh defects.
blind.from_above: From directly above, a reddish-brown roast pig is seen skewered lengthwise along a dark central spit axle with a turning crank at the southern end, set inside a rectangular stone-rimmed firebox filled with gravelly ash and coal.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (less than half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure), roughly 3.5 feet long, and about 1.5 feet wide.

notes: footprint proportion 1.74x off the catalog (6.0 x 2.6 ft)
